FN-YX4766-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 458
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Ernie Yarbrough
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/18/2023
House Bill 458 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Lawrence County
Commission by: (1) an estimated $15,500 annually by increasing the maximum number of
working days of the Lawrence County Board of Registrars from 160 days, under current law, to
200 days; and (2) and additional, undetermined amount dependent on the increase in mileage,
travel, and other expenses reimbursed to board members under current law due to the additional
working days provided by this bill. This bill would prohibit reimbursement of these expenses by
the state.
